work.title: The Second Philip K. Dick MEGAPACK

reading.synopsis: Published by Wildside Press in 2015 as part of their popular MEGAPACK e-book series and compiled as a companion to the first Philip K. Dick MEGAPACK volume, this anthology contains thirteen stories: The Unreconstructed M, Sales Pitch, Shell Game, Breakfast at Twilight, Adjustment Team, Foster, You're Dead, The Crawlers, The Golden Man, The Last of the Masters, The Turning Wheel, Upon the Dull Earth, Human Is, and Meddler. Publisher John Betancourt's note frames Dick as one of the iconic science fiction figures of the twentieth century whose reach now extends across books, movies, and television.
reading.significance: As an affordable digital anthology, this volume served readers discovering Dick's short fiction through screen adaptations -- 'Adjustment Team' (The Adjustment Bureau, 2011), 'Sales Pitch' and 'Human Is' (Electric Dreams), and 'The Golden Man' (loosely, Next, 2007) -- providing low-friction access to stories otherwise scattered across older, harder-to-find print anthologies.
reading.closing_note: This entry documents the anthology as a publishing object; readers seeking analysis of individual stories should consult each story's own dossier elsewhere in this corpus.
